default.$description: Default corner radius for controls such as buttons and inputs, and common elements like product or content containers.

insetMinimum.$description: The minimum radius of corners inset inside a padded surface; set to the none radius for strictly concentric corners.

default.$description: Default hairline for edges, dividers and outlines. Use stroke-width.none for an intentionally absent stroke.

focused.$description: Width of the keyboard focus ring, drawn in color.control.focusRing.

none.$description: No stroke. For transparent placeholder borders and zero outline offsets that must not change a component's size.

selected.$description: Stroke width marking a selected state, such as a selected content container or tab.
